name: The Coca-Cola Company
summary: The Coca-Cola Company, a beverage company, manufactures and sells various nonalcoholic beverages in the United States and internationally. The company provides Trademark Coca-Cola, sparkling soft drinks and flavors; water, sports, coffee, and tea; juice, value-added dairy, and plant-based beverages; and emerging beverages. It also offers beverage concentrates and syrups, as well as fountain syrups
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 70/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 29/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 67.62 USD (−31 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
